name: Intercontinental Lyon
positioning: InterContinental Lyon - Hotel Dieu, set in an 18th-century landmark building on Lyon's UNESCO-listed Peninsula, with a 32-metre Soufflot Dome, views of the Rhône and Fourvière, and a Cinq Mondes spa
best_for: Travelers who want a historic building at the heart of central Lyon, with views of the Rhône river and the basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourviere
Guests who want a city hotel with a Cinq Mondes spa and suites with river or courtyard views

facts.text: The hotel is at the heart of the Peninsula of Lyon, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
The hotel is located in a landmark building originally dating back to the 18th century.
L'Académie, the hotel's conference centre, is located in the most ancient part of the Grand Hôtel-Dieu.
Premium Rooms may include river, courtyard or garden views, and some are on the top floor.
The Junior Suite may include a river view.
The Cinq Mondes spa has a sauna and steam bathing, with a masseuse available.
The hotel has a fitness center.
Epona restaurant has an outdoor garden terrace, where chef Mathieu Charrois offers contemporary creations with local and seasonal flavours.
Le Dôme bar serves signature cocktails featuring local produce and local beers, from tea time to evening drinks.
The hotel's concierge helps guests discover Lyon, from off-the-beaten-path activities to restaurants and shows.

highlights.text: The Soufflot Dome on the first floor towers 32 metres high.
The hotel offers views of the Rhône river, the basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourviere, its historical courtyards and the city of Lyon.
The hotel has a Cinq Mondes Spa.
The Prestige Suite may include a furnished balcony and a courtyard view.

considerations.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
Lyon-Saint-Exupéry Airport is approximately 37 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that the urban setting may lack a quiet ambiance for some guests.
